text:
ajay: Heads-up — scheduling the v2 cutover tonight at 02:00 UTC. This is a dual-api cutover (v1 stays live). Need operator handoff, clear pinlist, and rollback triggers defined.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: v2-cutover @ 2024-08-18T02:00:00Z. To add a temporary pin, use `/deploy pin add <tenant>`; see /deploy help for rollback commands.

maria: Quick Q — are we pinning mobile-sdk tenants by default? Mobile SDK had that header case issue last time.

sam: Not by default. Recommend we pre-populate a mobile-exclude pinlist for 1 hour post-cutover for high-risk tenants (acct tiers + customers on old SDK).

leo: Agree. Also we should enable header-normalize shim on the gateway for the first 30m to reduce client 400s. I can flip it during handoff.

emily: Release notes draft updated in #release-notes-drafts. Callout: breaking change is header variant handling; migration steps + ephemeral pin instructions included.

ajay: Rollback criteria proposal: 1) global 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline sustained for 5m, 2) p95 latency increase > 1s sustained for 5m, or 3) v2 mapped client error rate > 0.8% and traffic segment > 5%. Thoughts?

sam: Add: evidence of client-side data corruption (invalid JSONs or schema errors spiking) => immediate rollback. Also tie rollback to canary tenant errors > 10% for 10m.

leo: For operator runbook: command to add tenant pin quickly: ```/deploy pin add tenant=TENANT_ID reason="mobile-exclude" expires=1h``` And to force fallback: ```/deploy route set tenant=TENANT_ID target=v1```

maria: I'll prepare a short notify template for CS + AMs to send to affected customers if we need to roll back. Keep wording minimal: "We're reverting an API change for your tenant to restore service."

emily: Also request: telemetry team — please ensure the v2-specific metrics dashboard has the following panels before cutover: p95, p99, 5xx count, client schema errors, tenant pins. Pinged @telemetry on the draft.

deploybot: Canary will start at 02:00 with 1% traffic to v2 for 10m, then 10% for 20m if metrics stable. Autopause on rollback triggers is enabled. Watch endpoint: https://metrics.internal/redwood/v2-cutover

ajay: Operator handoff — who can be primary during 02:00-04:00 UTC window? I want someone to own pins and the rollback decision.

sam: I can take primary and be oncall. Will monitor metrics and coordinate with CS.

leo: I'll be secondary and will own the header-normalize toggle and gateway rollbacks.

maria: I'll be on standby for customer comms + pin lists.

ajay: Thanks all. Final checklist before 02:00: - deploybot schedule confirmed (yes) - pinlist pre-seeded (maria) - operator primary (sam) - secondary (leo) - release notes posted (emily) - telemetry dashboard live (telemetry) If anything changes ping in this thread. :thumbsup:
